about: 整个细胞的电镜分割数据的目录：只存地址和出处，数据运行时从 OpenOrganelle 下载。 / A catalogue of whole-cell electron-microscopy segmentations: addresses and sources only; the data is downloaded from OpenOrganelle at run time.

cells.title: 一个 HeLa 细胞里的细胞器
cells.titleEn: The organelles of a HeLa cell
cells.caption: 聚焦离子束扫描电镜拍下的一整个 HeLa 细胞，各种细胞器由机器学习逐个体素分割出来。从上往下看，在半高处剖开；细胞膜没有画（它的褶皱会盖住里面的细胞器）。
cells.captionEn: An entire HeLa cell imaged by focused ion beam scanning electron microscopy, with each kind of organelle segmented voxel by voxel by machine learning. Seen from above and cut at mid-height; the cell membrane is not drawn (its folds would hide the organelles inside).
